hook: WHAT DO A MILLION DOTS DRAW?

package.title: 4 Random Rules Draw A Fern
alt_titles: A Million Random Dots Make A Fern
description: Four simple rules, each a stretch-and-turn of the plane, picked at random with fixed odds (1%, 85%, 7%, 7%). Apply one to a dot, then another, a million times.
The dots draw a fern: Michael Barnsley's iterated function system (1988).
package.question: Does it look real to you? 👇
package.pinned: The 85% rule makes each frond a smaller copy of the whole fern; the other three draw the stem and the first two leaves 🌿
